warnings: All bars are printed with Ø → type RB (section 0.6 / 6). No concrete strength or steel grade is printed anywhere in the set.

B is 0.07 wide (the block-wall thickness) with one bar top and one bottom and a single vertical link; B1's bar diameter '12' is written in heavier pen over another figure (a correction on the original) — read as 12 on both faces, flagged.

ขยายหัวเสา ก (slotted holes, เจาะรูยาว) is called out at the column on the row-A side of section ก-ก and ขยายหัวเสา ข (round holes, เจาะรูกลม) at the row-D side — the truss seat is slotted at one end only. These are connection details without a printed mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2).
